source: USDA Foreign Agricultural Service — Production, Supply and Distribution (PSD) database, api.fas.usda.gov
rules: countries: FAS country codes are FIPS; each is matched through its GENC code (ISO 3166 alpha-3) to the country reference — entries without one (regions, 'European Union' E4, 'Others') are not countries
season_year is FAS's MARKET year (the year the marketing year begins), not a calendar year
yield is FAS's published yield where it is in MT/HA, else derived as production / area

every unit is converted only by this table (dim + factor to tonnes, hectares or t/ha); a known unit of another dimension for a field (e.g. trees for area) leaves that field unread; a unit not listed is refused, never guessed
